As noted in the memo, Florida's DOT says it's issuing the order in response to the "recent exponential increase in deployments" of license plate readers, "coupled with concerning reports of misuse, data privacy concerns, and surveillance schemes." The new built-in option will block most third-party ads and trackers before they load on an iPhone, reducing bandwidth use and decluttering mobile websites. Mozilla is using Apple's WebKit Content Blocker technology and the EasyList filter to block ads in Firefox on iOS, so you won't need to download and install a separate extension to get it working.
